# miniz 3.0.2

Small zip library (MIT licence, see `LICENSE`), used to edit the delivery sheet
(`.xlsx` = a zip of XML files) in place: `src/delivery/XlsxEditor.cpp`.

- Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/download/3.0.2/miniz-3.0.2.zip
- SHA-256 of that zip: `ada38db0b703a56d3dd6d57bf84a9c5d664921d870d8fea4db153979fb5332c5`
- Files copied unchanged: `miniz.c`, `miniz.h`, `LICENSE` (the release "amalgamated" files).

Do not edit these files. To update: download a newer release, copy the same three
files, update this README, run the unit tests (they check the sheet round trip).
